articles.title: Union Cabinet Approves India Semiconductor Mission Phase-II with Focus on Advanced Packaging and R&D
articles.summary: Phase-II of the India Semiconductor Mission expands financial incentives to cover compound semiconductors, silicon photonics, and domestic equipment manufacturing.
prelims: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) operates under the Digital India Corporation within MeitY.
Phase-II shifts focus from foundational fab setup to advanced OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) and ATMP facilities.
Introduces targeted capital subsidies for local R&D institutions developing indigenous Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools.
articles.mains: Examine how India's Semiconductor Mission contributes to global supply chain resilience and analyze the key structural bottlenecks in domestic chip manufacturing.

articles.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Scope of Extraordinary Powers Under Article 142 in Environmental Protection Cases
articles.summary: The Supreme Court held that Article 142 cannot bypass statutory environmental impact assessment guidelines set under existing environmental protection acts.
prelims: Article 142 grants the Supreme Court inherent powers to pass orders necessary for doing 'complete justice' in any cause or matter.
The Court emphasized that 'complete justice' must align with statutory framework mandates rather than replacing statutory environmental clearance procedures.
Reinforced the application of the 'Precautionary Principle' and 'Polluter Pays Principle' as part of Article 21 rights.
articles.mains: Critically analyze the delicate balance between judicial activism under Article 142 and the doctrine of separation of powers in environmental governance.

articles.title: Implementation Framework for Global Goal on Adaptation (GGA) Finalized Ahead of UN Climate Summit
articles.summary: Developing nations present a unified framework establishing quantifiable indicators for climate adaptation funding and coastal protection resilience.
prelims: The Global Goal on Adaptation (GGA) was established under Article 7 of the Paris Agreement to enhance adaptive capacity and resilience.
The Framework utilizes thematic targets focusing on water security, food production, infrastructure, and ecosystem protection.
Unlike mitigation metrics (CO2 equivalent), adaptation metrics measure vulnerability reduction and ecosystem stability.
articles.mains: Discuss the challenges in establishing quantifiable indicators for the Global Goal on Adaptation (GGA) and highlight India's proactive climate adaptation strategies.

articles.title: Ministry of Labour Issues Draft Rules for Universal Registration of Platform Workers under Social Security Code
articles.summary: Draft rules mandate aggregator contribution to a dedicated social security fund to provide health, accident, and disability coverage for gig workers.
prelims: The Code on Social Security, 2020 explicitly defines 'gig workers' and 'platform workers' for the first time in Indian statutory law.
Proposes establishing a Social Security Board chaired by the Union Minister for Labour and Employment.
Mandates a statutory levy on aggregators ranging between 1% to 2% of their annual turnover for the welfare fund.
articles.mains: Evaluate the socio-economic impact of the gig economy in India and assess the adequacy of provisions under the Code on Social Security, 2020.

articles.title: DRDO Conducts Successful Flight Test of Indigenous Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile (NASM-MR)
articles.summary: The Naval Anti-Ship Missile Medium Range (NASM-MR) successfully demonstrated sea-skimming capability and precision targeting during sea trials.
prelims: NASM-MR is an indigenously developed air-launched anti-ship missile developed by DRDO for naval platform integration.
Employs an active radar seeker and sea-skimming capabilities to evade hostile shipborne radar defenses.
Powered by a solid-fuel booster paired with a turbojet engine for sustained high-subsonic cruise velocities.
articles.mains: Analyze how indigenous defense development enhances India's maritime domain awareness and strategic posture in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
